name: codex-app-sdk
description: Modular runtime, Electron and web bridges, and Vue kit for building Codex surfaces.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:workspaces
scripts.build:compat: vite build && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly && node scripts/package-katex-assets.mjs && node scripts/verify-package-css.mjs && node scripts/verify-native-assets.mjs
scripts.build:docs: npm run check:rpc && vitepress build docs
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/core && npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/backend && npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/vue && npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/electron && npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/web
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build:packages && npm run build:compat
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/core && npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/backend && npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/vue && npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/web && npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/basic-web-sample
scripts.build:workspaces: npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/component-lab && npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/basic-sample && npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/spark-sample && npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/relay-sample && npm run build -w @codex-app-sdk/basic-web-sample
scripts.check: npm run check:sdk && npm run check:workspaces:owned && npm run build:docs
scripts.check:compat: npm run lint:compat && npm run build:compat
scripts.check:packages: npm run check -w @codex-app-sdk/core && npm run check -w @codex-app-sdk/backend && npm run check -w @codex-app-sdk/vue && npm run check -w @codex-app-sdk/electron && npm run check -w @codex-app-sdk/web
scripts.check:sdk: npm run check:schema && npm run check:rpc && npm run check:release && npm run check:packages && npm run check:compat
scripts.check:workspaces: npm run build:sdk && npm run check:workspaces:owned
scripts.check:workspaces:owned: npm run check -w @codex-app-sdk/create-codex-app && npm run check -w @codex-app-sdk/component-lab && npm run check -w @codex-app-sdk/basic-sample && npm run check -w @codex-app-sdk/spark-sample && npm run check -w @codex-app-sdk/relay-sample && npm run check -w @codex-app-sdk/basic-web-sample
scripts.lint: npm run lint:sdk && npm run lint:workspaces
scripts.lint:packages: npm run lint -w @codex-app-sdk/core && npm run lint -w @codex-app-sdk/backend && npm run lint -w @codex-app-sdk/vue && npm run lint -w @codex-app-sdk/electron && npm run lint -w @codex-app-sdk/web
scripts.lint:sdk: npm run lint:packages && npm run lint:compat
scripts.lint:workspaces: npm run lint -w @codex-app-sdk/create-codex-app && npm run lint -w @codex-app-sdk/component-lab && npm run lint -w @codex-app-sdk/basic-sample && npm run lint -w @codex-app-sdk/spark-sample && npm run lint -w @codex-app-sdk/relay-sample && npm run lint -w @codex-app-sdk/basic-web-sample
scripts.mutation:all: npm run mutation:core && npm run mutation:web && npm run mutation:electron && npm run mutation:backend && npm run mutation:vue
scripts.test: npm run test:sdk && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.test:coverage:packages: npm run test:coverage -w @codex-app-sdk/core && npm run test:coverage -w @codex-app-sdk/backend && npm run test:coverage -w @codex-app-sdk/vue && npm run test:coverage -w @codex-app-sdk/electron && npm run test:coverage -w @codex-app-sdk/web
scripts.test:packages: npm test -w @codex-app-sdk/core && npm test -w @codex-app-sdk/backend && npm test -w @codex-app-sdk/vue && npm test -w @codex-app-sdk/electron && npm test -w @codex-app-sdk/web
scripts.test:workspaces: npm test -w @codex-app-sdk/create-codex-app && npm test -w @codex-app-sdk/component-lab && npm test -w @codex-app-sdk/basic-sample && npm test -w @codex-app-sdk/spark-sample && npm test -w @codex-app-sdk/relay-sample
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:sdk && npm run typecheck:workspaces
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck -w @codex-app-sdk/core && npm run typecheck -w @codex-app-sdk/backend && npm run typecheck -w @codex-app-sdk/vue && npm run typecheck -w @codex-app-sdk/electron && npm run typecheck -w @codex-app-sdk/web
scripts.typecheck:sdk: npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:compat
scripts.typecheck:workspaces: npm run typecheck -w @codex-app-sdk/component-lab && npm run typecheck -w @codex-app-sdk/basic-sample && npm run typecheck -w @codex-app-sdk/spark-sample && npm run typecheck -w @codex-app-sdk/relay-sample && npm run typecheck -w @codex-app-sdk/basic-web-sample
